items.name: sciviz-star-projects
items.description: Flagship scientific visualization projects: OVITO→Blender pipelines, PC2 bake, Geometry Nodes instancing, stable renders, scalable particle shapes.

items.name: AETHER
items.description: Interactive astronomy visualization project combining astrophysical animations, scientific storytelling, WebGL/Three.js scenes and browser-based simulations to make research concepts and space data easier to explore visually.

items.name: engineering-system-simulation
items.description: Built a simple animation in Python using SciPy and Matplotlib to visualize the solution of a nonlinear ODE system. The simulation demonstrates how a state variable governed by dx/dt = cos(x) gradually slows and converges to an equilibrium point at x = π/2. A great exercise in numerical integration, differential equations, and scientific visual

items.name: Interactive-Scientific-Simulation-and-Data-Visualization-Tool-for-Wave-Phenomena-Using-Python-
items.description: An interactive Python-based scientific simulation and data visualization tool for modeling radial wave propagation. Features real-time 3D animation and adjustable amplitude and frequency controls, built using NumPy and Matplotlib. Developed to explore computational physics, mathematical modeling, and scientific visualization.

items.name: physix-studio
items.description: Open-source Python framework for deterministic physics simulation, scientific visualization, Manim animation, orbital mechanics, quantum scenes, and educational STEM video.

items.name: CFD-Navier-Stokes-Simulation
items.description: Beginner-friendly CFD project implementing 2D Navier–Stokes equations using Python. Includes numerical simulation, visualization, and animation of fluid flow using NumPy and Matplotlib. Ideal for learning fluid dynamics and scientific computing basics.

items.name: Space-Debris-Orbit-Simulation
items.description: 🌍 Space Debris Orbit Simulation built with Python, NumPy, and Matplotlib. This project visualizes Earth with realistic textures while simulating 100+ debris objects in orbit using real-time animation. Demonstrates orbital motion, scientific visualization, mathematical modeling, and Python programming concepts.

items.name: -Oscillating-electric-dipole-animation-example-
items.description: Animation of an oscillating electric dipole made in python in mp4 and gif format using the matplotlib visualization library and matplotlib.animation. Code used for the presentation of the paper "building videos from simulations for scientific dissemination" at the Latin American Free Software Festival (FLISOL) in 2019

items.name: visual-math
items.description: ▶ A collection of Python scripts that generate mathematical and scientific animation videos using Pillow and FFmpeg — fractals, sorting algorithms, physics simulations, number theory, ML visualizations, and more.

items.name: ChemFlow
items.description: **ChemFlow** is an interactive web application designed for scientific visualization, simulations, and data analysis. It leverages **React Three Fiber** for 3D graphics, **React Flow** for flow-based diagrams, and **Chart.js** for data visualization. With built-in support for animations, complex calculations, and PDF exports.

items.name: CMathLib
items.description: CMathLib is a high-performance, GPU-accelerated math library for large-scale computations, offering vector, matrix, quaternion operations, and transformations. Optimized for game development, 3D modeling, VR/AR, scientific visualization, CAD, machine learning, robotics, simulation, graphics rendering, and animation software.
